description: What moved, as the site's changes show it: every listed GPU and company index's change over 1, 5, 7 or 30 days (the site's 1D, 5D, 1W and 1M), largest first, and every AI model whose price (at the mix, as its page charts it) moved over that time.

errata.description: Errors found in the values the change is measured between (on from_date, to_date or the days in from_between): the change is that of the values as published. As the page notes them under its value and the status page lists them: each a run of index days. A final value is never changed; the correct one is given when it can be recomputed, and the error is fixed from the next day

correct.description: The correct index value (none when it cannot be recomputed)

published.description: The index value as published those days (none when it differs from day to day)

reason.description: Why it was wrong, as the status page says

from_between.description: With from_interpolated: the days before and after from_date it is taken between

from_interpolated.description: The history has no value on from_date: the change is measured from the value that day taken between the two days in from_between, as the change cell's hover says

from_value.description: The value on from_date (none when it is estimated)
